mapper.select: WITH per_order AS ( SELECT w.id,w.assigned_technician_id, CASE WHEN w.status='PENDING_ACCEPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS W, CASE WHEN w.status='IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT (w.current_round>1 AND prev.acceptance_passed=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS I, CASE WHEN w.status='IN_PROGRESS' AND w.current_round>1 AND prev.acceptance_passed=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS R, CASE WHEN w.status='PENDING_ACCEPTANCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS A FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN repair_round prev ON prev.work_order_id=w.id AND prev.round_no=w.current_round-1 WHERE w.status IN ('PENDING_ACCEPT','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE') ), loads AS ( SELECT assigned_technician_id AS technician_id,SUM(W) AS W,SUM(I) AS I,SUM(R) AS R,SUM(A) AS A FROM per_order GROUP BY assigned_technician_id ), completions AS ( SELECT accepted_technician_id AS technician_id,COUNT(*) AS D FROM work_order WHERE status='COMPLETED' AND completed_at>=#{start} AND completed_at<#{end} GROUP BY accepted_technician_id ), recent AS ( SELECT technician_id,MAX(assigned_at) AS last_assigned_at FROM work_order_assignment GROUP BY technician_id ) SELECT u.id,COALESCE(l.W,0) AS W,COALESCE(l.I,0) AS I,COALESCE(l.R,0) AS R,COALESCE(l.A,0) AS A, COALESCE(c.D,0) AS today_completed,r.last_assigned_at FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN loads l ON l.technician_id=u.id LEFT JOIN completions c ON c.technician_id=u.id LEFT JOIN recent r ON r.technician_id=u.id WHERE u.role='TECHNICIAN'
